कोजागर m. (-रः) The day of full-moon in the month of Ashwin, (Septm-
ber-October.)
 E. कः who जागर wakeful; who is awake the call of
LAKṢMĪ, who descending on this night, promised wealth to all
that were awake: hence the night is spent in festivity, and
games of chance in honour of the goddess.
